text: だれにも　まけたく　ない！

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to'; changed to たくない it means 'don't want to'. まけたく　ない = 'I don't want to lose'.

patterns.name: だれにも〜ない
patterns.span: だれにも　まけたく　ない
patterns.explanation: だれ with も and a 'not' ending means 'nobody' or 'not anyone'; に shows who you would lose to. だれにも　まけたく　ない = 'I don't want to lose to anyone'.
